patch.description: Updates the fields listed in update_mask; a listed field that is omitted from the body is cleared or reset to its default. A change to the content of custom.configuration or custom.targets creates a new version that carries over the schedules. An archived overlay can't be updated. Activation needs a target, and every schedule needs a future window. A version-creating change is rejected while a scheduled window is applying.

parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to update: name, description, tags, priorityOrder, active, custom, custom.configuration, custom.targets, schedules. A listed field that is omitted from the body is cleared (description, tags, custom.targets, schedules) or reset to its default (priorityOrder 0, active false); name, custom, and custom.configuration cannot be cleared. Unknown fields and * return 400.
parameters.name: update_mask

schema.description: Comma-separated fields to update: name, description, tags, priorityOrder, active, custom, custom.configuration, custom.targets, schedules. A listed field that is omitted from the body is cleared (description, tags, custom.targets, schedules) or reset to its default (priorityOrder 0, active false); name, custom, and custom.configuration cannot be cleared. Unknown fields and * return 400.
Configuration overlay field values for an update. Only fields listed in update_mask are applied.

active.description: Set true to activate or false to deactivate the overlay. With schedules, activation enables them, and deactivation pauses them and ends a running window.

custom.description: Custom overlay fields to update. Rejected for preset overlays.

name.description: Display name, unique among unarchived overlays.

priorityOrder.description: Merge precedence on a shared remote configuration: higher values win, and the newer overlay wins a tie.

schedules.description: Replaces the schedules of the latest version without creating a version. When the same request changes custom content, the list moves to the new version with new ids. Windows must not overlap; a window may start when another ends. Schedules are matched by startAt, duration, recurrence, and timeZone: a match keeps its id, and other schedules are removed. An empty list on an active overlay applies it continuously, right away.

tags.description: Tags attached to the configuration overlay. Replaces all tags.

items.description: Tags attached to the configuration overlay. Replaces all tags.

post.description: Archives a configuration overlay and all its versions. An active overlay must be deactivated before it is archived. Archiving an archived overlay succeeds.

ConfigurationOverlaySchedule.description: Activation schedule of a configuration overlay.

duration.description: Positive length of each window, such as "7200s". Must be shorter than the recurrence interval; for days, weeks, and months, shorter than the shortest interval in the schedule's time zone, such as a 23-hour daylight-saving day or the shortest month.

recurrence.description: Repeats the window. Omit for a one-off schedule.

startAt.description: Start of the first window. A new schedule needs a window that starts in the future and before terminationDate.

terminationDate.description: End of a recurring schedule: no window starts at or after it, and a running window ends at it. Must be in the future when set or changed. Rejected for a one-off schedule.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for daily, weekly, and monthly recurrence.

ConfigurationOverlayScheduleCreate.description: Activation schedule to create with a configuration overlay.

every.description: Number of units between window starts.

ConfigurationOverlayScheduleRecurrence.description: Interval between window starts. Days, weeks, and months follow the schedule's time zone: a monthly start on a missing day moves to the month's last day, a start time skipped by a daylight-saving change moves forward, and a repeated one uses the earlier instant.
